record_discrepancy.reason: The generation client used its obsolete default checkout path and therefore recorded 'not a git checkout'. The separately supplied and archived runtime-profile.json captures the actual healthy service checkout, commit, container and dependency snapshots immediately before generation.
record_discrepancy.resolution: Use this immutable-hash attestation together with the archived runtime profile; do not alter the original run record after generation.

commercial_interpretation: The cleanup-fork gate passes technically. Commercial release still remains blocked pending complete input/tool terms, dependency and market review.
